MINUTES
  SPECIAL CITY COUNCIL MEETING
  JULY 9, 2024

1.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER

A Special meeting of the City Council of the City of Rolling Hills Estates was called to order
at 6:30 PM.

2.  ROLL CALL

City Council Members Present:  Brown Schachter, Huff, Zerunyan
City Council Members Absent:  Schmitz, Stegura

3.  CLOSED SESSION

A.  CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL - ANTICIPATED LITIGATION
  Government Code Section 54956.9(d)(2)
  Significant exposure to litigation: one potential case

  NO REPORTABLE ACTION.

5.  ADJOURNMENT

The Special City Council meeting adjourned at 7:00 PM to the regular City Council meeting.

Submitted by,  Approved by,

Lauren Pettit  Mayor
City Clerk
